sql:
SELECT
  family,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY age_days_at_last_seen) AS median_age_days
FROM fct_posting
WHERE
  is_open AND remote_us AND is_canonical_listing
GROUP BY
  family
